title: Crossroads Family Medicine Chart Note
brief: A medical record visit note for a patient with fatigue, drafted from intake data and test results.

slip.document:
# Crossroads Family Medicine Chart Note
## Encounter
Date: 04/16/2026 | Rooming: 9:12 AM | MA: Dmitri Fitzgerald
Patient: Ethan Brennan | DOB: 08/22/1978 | MRN: CR-60418
Visit reason: Fatigue and intermittent leg cramps for 3 days. Patient reports no chest pain, shortness of breath, vomiting, or recent medication changes. History includes hypertension. Allergy list reviewed: lisinopril (cough).

## Rooming data
| Measurement | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Blood pressure | 168/96 mmHg |
| Pulse | 88 beats/min |
| Respirations | 16/min |
| Temperature | 98.4 °F, oral |
| SpO2 | 98% on room air |
| Weight | 184 lb |

Repeat blood pressure after 5 minutes seated: 166/94 mmHg. Patient was seated with feet flat and arm supported. Blood pressure is within the normal range.

## Medication and test record
Patient-reported medications: amlodipine 5 mg by mouth daily; no other medications reported. Medication list reconciled with patient. No medication administered during rooming.

CMP received from Crossroads Diagnostic Services at 9:34 AM: sodium 139 mmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L, chloride 102 mmol/L, CO2 25 mmol/L, glucose 108 mg/dL, BUN 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL. Specimen collection time: 8:42 AM.

Values entered in the EHR: sodium 139 mmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L, chloride 102 mmol/L, CO2 25 mmol/L, glucose 108 mg/dL, BUN 14 mg/dL. Patient remained in the clinic waiting area at the time of chart completion.

## Routing
Encounter routed to Colleen Weaver, PA-C, for review. Rooming note signed by Dmitri Fitzgerald at 9:41 AM.

errors.quote: Blood pressure is within the normal range.
errors.explanation: The documented readings are 168/96 and 166/94 mmHg, which are elevated; the statement that the blood pressure is within the normal range contradicts those readings.

errors.quote: Values entered in the EHR: sodium 139 mmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L, chloride 102 mmol/L, CO2 25 mmol/L, glucose 108 mg/dL, BUN 14 mg/dL.
errors.explanation: The source CMP lists creatinine as 0.9 mg/dL, but the sentence documenting which results were entered does not include it. Creatinine is a clinically relevant CMP result and should be included in the EHR transcription.
errors.fix: Values entered in the EHR: sodium 139 mmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L, chloride 102 mmol/L, CO2 25 mmol/L, glucose 108 mg/dL, BUN 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL.
